lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਵਾਰਾਂ ਤੇ ਵਧੀਕ ॥ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok vaaraa(n) te vadheek || mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Saloks In Addition To The Vaars. First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਤੰਗੀ ਪੈਓਹਰੀ ਗਹਿਰੀ ਗੰਭੀਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: uta(n)gee paioharee gahiree ga(n)bheeree ||
lines.translation: O you with swollen breasts, let your consciousness become deep and profound.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਸੁੜਿ ਸੁਹੀਆ ਕਿਵ ਕਰੀ ਨਿਵਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਥਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sasuR suheeaa kiv karee nivan na jaai thanee ||
lines.translation: O mother-in-law, how can I bow? Because of my stiff nipples, I cannot bow.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਚੁ ਜਿ ਲਗਾ ਗਿੜਵੜੀ ਸਖੀਏ ਧਉਲਹਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gach j lagaa giRavaRee sakheee dhaulaharee ||
lines.translation: O sister, those mansions built as high as mountains

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਭੀ ਢਹਦੇ ਡਿਠੁ ਮੈ ਮੁੰਧ ਨ ਗਰਬੁ ਥਣੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: se bhee dhahade dith mai mu(n)dh na garab thanee ||1||
lines.translation: - I have seen them come crumbling down. O bride, do not be so proud of your nipples. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਮੁੰਧੇ ਹਰਣਾਖੀਏ ਗੂੜਾ ਵੈਣੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sun mu(n)dhe haranaakheee gooRaa vain apaar ||
lines.translation: O bride with deer-like eyes, listen to the words of deep and infinite wisdom.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲਾ ਵਸਤੁ ਸਿਞਾਣਿ ਕੈ ਤਾਂ ਕੀਚੈ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: pahilaa vasat sinjaan kai taa(n) keechai vaapaar ||
lines.translation: First, examine the merchandise, and then, make the deal.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੋਹੀ ਦਿਚੈ ਦੁਰਜਨਾ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾਂ ਕੂੰ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: dohee dichai durajanaa mitraa(n) koo(n) jaikaar ||
lines.translation: Proclaim that you will not associate with evil people; celebrate victory with your friends.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਦੋਹੀ ਸਜਣ ਮਿਲਨਿ ਲਹੁ ਮੁੰਧੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jit dohee sajan milan lahu mu(n)dhe veechaar ||
lines.translation: This proclamation, to meet with your friends, O bride - give it some thought.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਸਜਣਾ ਐਸਾ ਹਸਣੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: tan man deejai sajanaa aisaa hasan saar ||
lines.translation: Surrender mind and body to the Lord your Friend; this is the most excellent pleasure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਸਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਨ ਕੀਚਈ ਜਿ ਦਿਸੈ ਚਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis sau nehu na keechaee j disai chalanahaar ||
lines.translation: Do not fall in love with one who is destined to leave.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਇਵ ਕਰਿ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jinhee iv kar bujhiaa tinhaa vitahu kurabaan ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those who understand this. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਤੂੰ ਤਾਰੂ ਪਾਣਿ ਤਾਹੂ ਪੁਛੁ ਤਿੜੰਨੑ ਕਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: je too(n) taaroo paan taahoo puchh tiRa(n)nh kal ||
lines.translation: If you wish to swim across the water, then consult those who know how to swim.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾਹੂ ਖਰੇ ਸੁਜਾਣ ਵੰਞਾ ਏਨੑੀ ਕਪਰੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: taahoo khare sujaan va(n)njaa enhee kaparee ||3||
lines.translation: Those who have survived these treacherous waves are very wise. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਝੜ ਝਖੜ ਓਹਾੜ ਲਹਰੀ ਵਹਨਿ ਲਖੇਸਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jhaR jhakhaR ohaaR laharee vahan lakhesaree ||
lines.translation: The storm rages and the rain floods the land; thousands of waves rise and surge.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਆਲਾਇ ਬੇੜੇ ਡੁਬਣਿ ਨਾਹਿ ਭਉ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: satigur siu aalaai beRe duban naahi bhau ||4||
lines.translation: If you cry out for help from the True Guru, you have nothing to fear - your boat will not sink. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕੈਸੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak duneeaa kaisee hoee ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, what has happened to the world?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਲਕੁ ਮਿਤੁ ਨ ਰਹਿਓ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: saalak mit na rahio koee ||
lines.translation: There is no guide or friend.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਬੰਧੀ ਹੇਤੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaaee ba(n)dhee het chukaaiaa ||
lines.translation: There is no love, even among brothers and relatives.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਦੀਨੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: duneeaa kaaran deen gavaaiaa ||5||
lines.translation: For the sake of the world, people have lost their faith. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੈ ਹੈ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਓਹਿ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: hai hai kar kai ohi karen ||
lines.translation: They cry and weep and wail.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਲੑਾ ਪਿਟਨਿ ਸਿਰੁ ਖੋਹੇਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: galhaa pitan sir khohen ||
lines.translation: They slap their faces and pull their hair out.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਲੈਨਿ ਅਰੁ ਕਰਨਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naau lain ar karan samaai ||
lines.translation: But if they chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, they shall be absorbed into it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: naanak tin balihaarai jaai ||6||
lines.translation: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to them. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਡੀਗਿ ਨ ਡੋਲੀਐ ਸੀਧੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਧਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: re man deeg na doleeai seedhai maarag dhaau ||
lines.translation: O my mind, do not waver or walk on the crooked path; take the straight and true path.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਛੈ ਬਾਘੁ ਡਰਾਵਣੋ ਆਗੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਤਲਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: paachhai baagh daraavano aagai agan talaau ||
lines.translation: The terrible tiger is behind you, and the pool of fire is ahead.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਸੈ ਜੀਅਰਾ ਪਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਮਾ ਕਉ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਢੰਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahasai jeearaa par rahio maa kau avar na dha(n)g ||
lines.translation: My soul is skeptical and doubtful, but I cannot see any other way to go.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਿਉ ਸੰਗੁ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh chhuteeai har preetam siu sa(n)g ||7||
lines.translation: O Nanak, as Gurmukh, dwell with your Beloved Lord, and you shall be saved. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਘੁ ਮਰੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: baagh marai man maareeai jis satigur deekhiaa hoi ||
lines.translation: The tiger is killed, and the mind is killed, through the Teachings of the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਮਰਣਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap pachhaanai har milai bahuR na maranaa hoi ||
lines.translation: One who understands himself, meets with the Lord, and never dies again.
